_comment: Copy to config.json. Leave paths empty to auto-detect via PATH. No personal paths are required.
_comment_token_defaults: Leave blank/default for automatic low-context behavior. Set AGENT_BROKER_TOOL_PROFILE=full or mcp_tool_profile=full if an MCP client needs every internal bridge tool.
_comment_contract: compact_task_contract keeps the per-message ground-rules block out of the chat: it writes the full rules once to ~/.agent-broker/AGENT_GROUND_RULES.md and the delivered message only references that path. Set false for the legacy inline rules.
_comment_cdp: CDP model auto-selection is off by default; the debug port is unauthenticated. Opt in only after launching the IDE with --remote-debugging-port.
_comment_cli_backends: Register arbitrary local CLIs so route_agent_task(target_agent=<name>, prompt=...) routes to them. Two backend types: (1) type=cli (default) runs a subprocess — command (string or arg array), args_template (argv tokens before the prompt; placeholders {model}/{effort}/{timeout} allowed), prompt_arg (the argv tail carrying the prompt; default '{prompt}'), model_aliases, default_model, output_format (plain_text|stdout|json), json_path (only for output_format=json); (2) type=openai_compat calls a local OpenAI-compatible HTTP serve (base_url like http://localhost:11434/v1, optional api_key, default_model). Only {prompt}/{model}/{effort}/{timeout} are substituted; no shell is used.

ollama-http.description: Local Ollama via OpenAI-compatible HTTP serve

_comment_cli_backends_plugin: Alternatively, drop a .py file into ~/.agent-broker/cli-backends/ (or $AGENT_BROKER_CLI_BACKENDS_DIR) that defines a `backend` instance or `make_backend()` returning a CliBackend. No config edit needed. See docs/cli-adapter-design.md §12.3 for the plugin contract.
_comment_routing_preferences: Optional: route an ambiguous target_agent (no explicit target) to a preferred backend by task type. Keys: coding/review/writing/research/fast/general. Values are ordered backend names (built-in or custom). Task type is inferred from prompt keywords (中英文).
_comment_providers: Declarative execution layers for the decision-layer AI. Two types: (1) official_cli = a locally-installed official CLI (cli: claude|codex|gemini); availability requires it to be logged in. (2) openai_compat = any OpenAI-compatible relay/local server (base_url + optional api_key via 'env:XXX' or literal, models). Decision layer lists them with `list_providers`, then calls route_agent_task(target_agent=<provider>, target_model=<model>).
